observed: The official Jacobson tour text establishes fluorescence microscopy and vacuum-controlled microfluidic valves. The locally available tour JPEG is only a title card, not an apparatus photograph.

No usable apparatus still or measured room plan was recovered for this repair pass. The original microscope family and room remain representative, not a visual reconstruction of an identified Indiana instrument.
implemented: Connected focus arm and column guide; supported X crossrail, connected open X carriage and Y bearing strips; a continuous open stage plate with four matching contact proxies.
Supported transparent slide ends with actual retaining pads and brackets, plus four controller feet that meet the counter.
Contact-capable objective barrels, with a longer active objective and shorter parked barrels clearing the retained focus and XY travel.
Channel centreline traces have the declared 100 micrometre width. The glass, traces, capped ports and their placement are original illustrative geometry.
Pressure-controller leads terminate on supported fixed docks; chip ports move with their caps. There is no false rigid connection between controller and moving chip.

A measured dry operation offsets the loaded stage, registers the actual free carrier to the optical axis, positions the objective at a declared geometric distance, inspects and returns without resetting or assigning live qpos.
authored_assumptions: Bearing geometry uses ideal slide joints and 0.2 mm fixed-to-moving guide clearances. This avoids redundant friction constraints; it is not an OEM bearing preload, friction or stiffness model.

Objective lengths are shortened to preserve the original full travel below the slide and retaining structure. The active geometric objective-to-slide gap spans 5.3 to 12.3 mm; this is not calibrated optical working distance or autofocus.
The original 6 x 6 x 2 mm rigid inert carrier and its free joint remain. Registration is a geometric mechanical operation, not cell manipulation or robot loading.
The 100 micrometre coloured traces are not resolved channel walls; no fluid network, pressure propagation or biological process is simulated.
remaining_capabilities: Pressure-connected flexible tubing with credible slack and endpoint mechanics through XY travel.
Validated optics, calibrated focus, fluorescence and fluid transport.
A usable apparatus photograph or multiple views establishing the real Indiana microscope and room layout.
indiana_microfluidics.media_policy: No source photographs, video frames, logos or manufacturer CAD are embedded or redistributed. All added geometry is authored.
